from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RevenueGrowthData(BaseModel):
    """One record extracted from a single financial report containing the revenue growth metric."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024 Q1')")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the document for the metric")
    growth_rate: str | None = Field(description="The reported growth rate as a string (e.g., '26.27%')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document showing the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    revenue_growth_records: list[RevenueGrowthData]
